item.title: Lindsay Clancy back in court seeking to dismiss murder charges after mistrial
item.description:
On Wednesday this week, the Supreme Court will hear oral argument in Guerrero, Director of the Texas Department of Criminal Justice v. Dexter Johnson . It is a capital case involving the kidnapping, rape, and murder of Maria Aparece that Johnson committed in 2006. The case does not involve any claim Johnson is innocent of these heinous crimes, but rather how to interpret provisions in the Antiterrorism and Effective Death Penalty Act of 1996 (AEDPA). AEDPA prohibits successive habeas applications by state prisoners with only two narrow exceptions, including for claims that "rel[y] on a new rule of constitutional law, made retroactive to cases on collateral review by the Supreme Court, that was previously unavailable." 28 U.S.C. § 2244(b)(2)(A). item.title: Supermarket freezers across Europe hit by second suspected cyber-attack
item.description:
Chains in at least seven countries say fridge temperatures rose overnight in incident similar to hack of French stores Supermarket chains in at least seven European countries have said the temperatures of refrigerators and freezers in dozens of their stores soared overnight, prompting fears of a cyber-attack similar to one that caused millions of euros of losses in France. Retailers in Belgium, Estonia, Ireland, Finland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Sweden reported problems with their refrigeration systems on Monday, and several companies confirmed they had been victims of a cyberattack. item.title: Paxton vs. Talarico: Five things to watch in Texas’ tight U.S. Senate race
item.description:
A gas pump at a gas station in Allagash, Maine on October 14, 2026. Photo by CHARLY TRIBALLEAU / AFP via Getty Images. The state of Maine shattered another statewide record for heating oil prices this week. On October 29 , the Department of Energy Resources (DOER)’s weekly survey showed average statewide heating fuel prices rising to $6.05 per gallon as of October 26. This broke the previous record average statewide prices of $6.04 set on October 22, and $6.02 per gallon on September 21. The record-shattering heating prices are taking their toll on Mainers ahead of the midterm elections on November 3. Roughly half of Mainers rely on heating oil as their principal energy source in winter—compared with just 3% nationwide—meaning Mainers face an increase of thousands of dollars in heating. item.title: Ukraine and Russia report fake emergency alerts after cyberattacks target apps
item.description:
Authorities in Ukraine and Russia said their emergency alert mobile apps had been targeted by cyberattacks, with users in Ukraine receiving false warnings of an imminent nuclear threat. Moscow said that hackers had sent fake emergency alerts after gaining access to the Russian Emergency Situations Ministry’s mobile app, and that efforts were ongoing to restore the app's functionality.

item.title: Sir Patrick Stewart, RIP
item.description:
Patrick Stewart, as Captain Jean-Luc Picard. (CBS) The great British actor Sir Patrick Stewart passed away on Thursday . While Stewart began his career as a stage actor and performed in many Shakespeare plays, he is best known for his portrayal of Captain Jean-Luc Picard, in Star Trek: The Next Generation . Thanks to his impressive performance, Stewart and the character he played became science fiction icons. Stewart brought extraordinary depth and perception to the role. And the character is an interesting contrast to the more instinctive and aggressive, less cerebral, Captain Kirk in the original Star Trek Series . Perhaps more than any other character, Stewart's Picard epitomized Star Trek's progressive liberal values: Enlightenment rationalism, technological optimism (highlighted by his defense of the rights of the android Data ), racial and ethnic equality, and commitment to peace…

item.title: Freezers at supermarkets in several European countries hit by apparent cyberattacks, ruining food
item.description:
Stores and supermarkets across Belgium, Luxembourg, Finland, Estonia and Sweden all reported early Monday abrupt temperature spikes in their fridges and freezers in an apparent cyberattack targeting refrigeration units. The incidents follow a similar attack that hit hundreds of supermarkets across France in October, triggering food loss and fires.

item.title: The Biggest Upset of Election Night Could Come From South Carolina
item.description:
On Tuesday evening, a week before Election Day, Maggie O’Neal took her husband and two daughters—six and 10 years old—to see Dr. Annie Andrews, the pediatrician trying to flip a Senate seat in deep-red South Carolina, speak in Greenville. O’Neal, who grew up in a Republican household but votes Democrat, was “very early on the Dr. Annie bandwagon.” For about a decade, she worked as a hospice social worker; her father is a retired physician and her husband a practicing doctor. In Andrews, she recognized the dedication to years of study—in the Democratic challenger’s case at the University of Cincinnati College of Medicine—and the commitment to evidence-based research. “The strongest, most amazing physicians I’ve ever met and watched go through medical training are women,” O’Neal, 39, said. “The amount of work they have to do to succeed and thrive, and what they have to endure says a lot…
